redmod.deployCommandPolicy: Use the repository deploy helper for deterministic/probe deployment; do not reconstruct raw redMod.exe argument quoting from old docs/chat because the first attended probe proved exit-code-zero false positives are possible when the root argument is ignored.
redmod.launcherOffContract: activation marker absent => all Biology behavior inactive even if supplemental REDscript/frameworks remain loaded

firstPartyFiles.selection: all current .reds files accepted by tools/Build-OwnedAcceptance.ps1; runtime build gates are opened only in immutable staged copies; runtime behavior additionally requires the active REDmod marker

redscript.launcherOff: may remain loaded; Biology hooks fail closed through CRRealpassSettings
redscript.reason: Biology runtime/presentation use narrow additive/wrapper seams whose whole-file REDmod replacement would broaden patch/conflict surface.

mod-settings.launcherOff: may remain loaded; saved enabled=true cannot override absent REDmod marker
mod-settings.reason: Current persistent provider for the existing two provider-neutral preferences; remove when a smaller accepted provider or boundary replaces it.

archivexl.launcherOff: may remain loaded; not activation authority
archivexl.reason: Retained only because the current Mod Settings adapter depends on it.

red4ext.launcherOff: loader may remain active; not activation authority
red4ext.reason: Retained only as transitive plumbing for ArchiveXL/Mod Settings; Biology has no project-owned RED4ext plugin.

uninstallPolicy.biologyOwned: delete exact-hash, allowlisted Biology paths only
uninstallPolicy.preferences: preserve by default; optional Biology section removal only
uninstallPolicy.redmodRefresh: official redMod.exe deploy with explicit root; no recursive shared-cache deletion

acceptedDirectGameEvidence: official REDmod executable/version/module contract on Cyberpunk 2077 2.31
real five-stage REDmod deployment with explicit game root
remainingDirectGameGates: combined-candidate launcher activation marker exact compile/deploy
launcher OFF vanilla behavior with supplemental runtime still installed
self-contained hard uninstall plus REDmod refresh
rules: mods/Biology is the authoritative first-party REDmod package identity and launcher activation authority.
Build-BiologyPackage.ps1 must exact-compile the complete merged REDscript runtime against the supported installed Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 bundle before it emits a playable ZIP.
The build may not modify or deploy to the game installation.
Every installed payload file must be individually recorded with owner, component, route, uninstall policy and SHA-256; shared roots are never recursively Biology-owned.
Generic dependency files are inventoried for collision/update safety but preserved by normal player uninstall.
No Dark Future or Project E3 executing content may enter the package.
No stock Cyberpunk executable, archive, script bundle, save, settings file, or other proprietary game payload may enter the package.
Mod Settings/ArchiveXL/RED4ext remain temporary current-candidate dependencies only while a current accepted preference consumer justifies them.
CI and exact compilation are not live-game acceptance; each remaining direct-game gate stays open until the parent integration thread records it.
